message.content: The agent finalized the RecoveredModel (3-layer encoder, 1-layer decoder), fixed shape bugs in tune.py, tuned only output_layer via least squares to reduce MSE from 1.551 to 0.162 (and 1.543 to 0.809 for the src-input convention), saved /app/model.pt in TorchScript, and verified all success criteria including unchanged weights.pt.
